question: Across all 944 matched original Stage1 0bp Tiered own-state sessions, do cash opportunity and SOXL-relative selection losses coincide with original allocation intent, own-state cap binding, or HOLD, and how do weak and good intervals differ? This is diagnostic attribution, not a policy counterfactual.

fixed_definitions.raw_nominal_beta: 3*frame.soxl_weight + frame.soxx_weight, original allocation output before own-state risk projection
fixed_definitions.ending_beta: 3*path.ending_soxl_weight+path.ending_soxx_weight, end-of-interval own-state descriptive weight, not open target
fixed_definitions.cash_loss: component daily cash_opportunity_log from independently closed physical-account Qlib Recorder
fixed_definitions.selection_loss: component daily SOXL_selection_log from same physical-account Recorder
fixed_definitions.all_intervals: 944 sessions, four calendar years (2023/2026 partial), all16 quarters and all819 contiguous 126-session windows
fixed_definitions.decision_clocks: Require feature_available_at < decision_at, compare all same signal/trade/exit dates; no future outcome used as a feature or tradable switch.

diagnostic_outputs: All quarterly/year/rolling physical component sums and mean original alpha/tail probabilities, raw nominal beta, own-state cap, ending beta, cap-binding fraction, open execute fraction and cash weight; calculate cash/selection loss sums on cap binding and nonbinding dates descriptively. No subset chosen as strategy.
stop: Any source hash, exact 944 dates, native component closure, annual/quarter/rolling consistency or Qlib DatasetH failure stops. Do not replay an account, change cap, fit, bootstrap or use posthoc group results as a policy.
